youtube.title: Napoleon Wasn't Short. A British Cartoonist Made You Think So
youtube.description:
Napoleon's height was recorded as 5 feet 2 inches, but in French units, and the French inch was longer than the English one. Converted, he stood roughly 5'6" to 5'7", about average or slightly above for a Frenchman of his time. The image of a tiny, tantrum-throwing Napoleon was popularized by British cartoonist James Gillray, whose "Little Boney" stuck. "Le petit caporal" was a term of affection from his soldiers, and his elite guards were selected partly for height.

📂 Case File #059: Napoleon's Height
